tests.code:
from shipping import fee

def test_exact_free_shipping_threshold():
    result = fee(10000)
    assert isinstance(result, int)
    assert not isinstance(result, bool)
    assert result == 0
tests.quote: For a built-in int amount_cents of at least 10000, shipping.fee(amount_cents) returns the integer 0 cents, including exactly 10000.
tests.purpose: Check the explicitly included threshold and integer zero result.
